faq: Will you edit the Magento core files?
No. Core edits are overwritten at upgrade time and cause trouble later. We work in your theme or a child theme and in layout XML, so your store stays upgrade friendly.
Do you work on a staging copy?
Yes. We ask for a staging site or set one up on your host, make the changes there and send you a link. We deploy to your live store only after you approve.
Which Magento versions do you support?
Magento 2 and Adobe Commerce 2.x, including Luma, Hyva and custom themes. Magento 1 is end of life, so for a Magento 1 store we recommend a migration instead of new edits.
What if my theme is heavily customized?
Send us access to the repository or a copy of the theme folder. We review it before quoting any extra work and tell you plainly if a change would be risky, then suggest a safer way.
desc:
Magento theme edits and template fixes change how your storefront looks and behaves without touching Magento core code. Ecom Swift LLC makes layout, style and template changes on a staging copy first and goes live only after you approve.

## What are Magento theme edits?

Magento theme edits are changes made to the files that control your storefront's look and layout: stylesheets, templates, layout files and CMS blocks. Typical jobs include fixing a broken mobile view, moving a block on the product page, changing the header, adding a banner or building a new page template.

The edits happen in your child theme or existing custom theme. That keeps your changes separate from Magento's own files, so updates remain possible.

## Why theme work needs care on Magento

Magento themes follow strict rules. Templates, layout updates and styles are compiled and cached, so a change that looks right in one place can fail in another, or appear only after the static content is redeployed. Editing the wrong file, such as one inside the core or a vendor theme, can disappear at the next update or break the store.

A staging copy removes that risk. You see the change working before customers do, and a wrong edit never reaches a live checkout.

## How theme edits affect your results

Small design faults cost real orders. A buy button pushed below the fold on a phone, a banner that overlaps text or a menu that will not open can stop a purchase. Fixing them improves the buyer's path without changing your products or prices.

Good theme work also lowers maintenance cost. Clean code in a child theme means the next developer can follow it, and future changes take less time. We cannot promise a change in sales, since traffic and offers matter too, but a clear, working storefront gives them the best chance to count.

## What good Magento theme work includes

- Changes made in a child theme or your existing custom theme, never in core files.
- A staging copy for every edit, with before and after screenshots.
- CSS and text adjustments that respect your brand fonts and colors.
- Template and layout changes to move, add or remove blocks.
- Banners and CMS blocks created or updated through the admin.
- Header and footer changes that work on every page.
- Product page layout tweaks for price, gallery and buy button.
- New CMS page layouts or templates for landing pages.
- Cache cleared and static content redeployed so changes show correctly.
- A browser and device check, with a written change log in the larger package.

## How we handle your edits

You send a list of changes, ideally with screenshots or links to the pages involved. We confirm what each one means and flag anything that needs more than a theme edit, such as new functionality, which belongs to extension work.

We then work on staging. After each change, we clear caches, redeploy static content where needed and check the result on desktop and mobile. You receive a link to review. When you approve, we apply the same changes to the live store and take a backup first.

The Basic package covers a few small layout or style fixes. The Standard package covers more edits plus a new CMS page or template, header and footer work and product page tweaks. The Premium package covers the largest round, with several new templates, a properly set up child theme, device testing and a written change log.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Send screenshots with arrows or notes for each change.
- Tell us which pages and devices matter most.
- Keep a list of any custom code already in your theme.
- Review the staging link on a phone.
- Approve in writing before the live update.

**Avoid:**
- Editing theme files directly on the live store.
- Changing vendor or core files to get a quick result.
- Piling up small unrelated requests after approval.
- Installing a new extension to move one button.
- Skipping the mobile check.

## Who it is for

This service suits a store owner whose product page looks broken on certain phones and who needs a clean fix. It also suits a marketer who wants a new landing page template without hiring a full agency. A third case is a store with an older custom theme where small changes keep breaking something else.

## What we need from you

Send your list of changes, example pages and any design files or references. We need staff, collaborator or developer access to your Magento admin and a staging copy, or help to create one. We never need passwords, and nothing is changed on the live store without your approval.
